The '''Sakiya slave uprising''' was a brief slave uprising on [[Sakiya]] during which several [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] warehouses were burned to the ground. After it was over, the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] focused on bringing the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyans]] back into line.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=crewskill|Scavenging|A Revolting Development}}</ref>
